title: Another Dharma Talk on Dharma Position
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Our experiences in life may not be as straightforward or separate as we think they are, but rather interconnected and influenced by our minds and past experiences. This understanding is at the heart of the concept of "Dharma position" in Zen Buddhism, which encourages us to see things as they are, with all their complexities and imperfections, while also recognizing their emptiness and interconnectedness. By embracing this nuanced perspective, we can cultivate a deeper understanding of ourselves and the world around us, and approach life with greater hopefulness and possibility.
